Class ResourceBiomeSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.resource.ResourceBiomeSectionBuilder
public class ResourceBiomeSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Biomes, Flora, Soils, and Terrestrial/Aquatic Fauna.

Extracted from ResourceDistributionPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Encapsulates the biological and ecological modeling layer:

  • Plant Biomass invalid input: '&' Carbon Stocks: Terrestrial plant biomass (\(\mathrm{GtC}\)) and soil organic carbon (\(\mathrm{GtC}\)).
  • Heterotrophic Animal Stocks: Wild terrestrial animal biomass (\(\mathrm{GtC}\)) and marine/estuarine biomass (\(\mathrm{GtC}\)).
  • Categorical Biome Cartography: Polychrome discrete classification of 14 ecological biomes.
  • Empirical WMS Ingestion: Satellite ingestion from NASA MODIS (MCD12Q1 Land Cover Type).
